image_description: A black plastic rain barrel positioned outdoors against the siding of a house. A white downspout curves from the roofline into the top inlet of the barrel. The barrel is cylindrical with visible horizontal ridges and some surface staining. To the right, there is a small black bucket or planter on the ground near a foundation vent.

The horizontal lines of the siding and the foundation vent grille show very slight waviness, not perfectly straight, which may indicate minor geometric warping common in AI generations.
